name: Auto Swingshot
author: glawks
description: Automatically equip and fire the Swingshot near Versa-Targets, then return to your previous weapon.

settings.name: Swingshot activation
settings.description: Equip and use the Swingshot on a new Circle press near a target. Observe mode logs detected candidates on Circle presses without changing weapons. Restart after changing.

settings.name: Target radius
settings.description: Maximum geometric distance to a target in game units. Default 16, tuned from in-game connection tests; the game's own hooking rules still apply. Saved preferences override this default.

settings.name: Height difference
settings.description: Maximum vertical separation in game units. Default 7, based on in-game jumping tests; the game handles final attachment and release.

settings.name: Facing angle (degrees)
settings.description: Auto-equip only when a target is within this many degrees to the left or right of Ratchet's facing direction. Lower angles reduce accidental switches. Existing saved settings are preserved.
